summary: Motion 2.0 batch 2: leaner panel reversals and bounded rendering safeguards

changes.title: Less redundant artwork during panel reversal
changes.detail: Reuse the presented artwork for overlay-owned public controls instead of rendering unused native duplicates. Enforce one visual owner per shared control.

changes.title: Bounded geometry recovery
changes.detail: Limit internal layout-driven retargets to two per transition; normal taps and user-requested reversals retain their existing animation and hit targets.

changes.title: More useful transition diagnostics
changes.detail: Record Clipboard transitions, interruption, geometry retarget and fallback reason in the existing content-free diagnostic report.
